revisionDesc.change: Vote - AcceptText - I agree with the corrections and with the revisions by Borrelli, but ἐγ in line 11 is correct and doesn’t need regularization. In l. 17, τον needs an accent. In l. 24, there seems to have been written another letter between δημοσίων and πάντων, maybe expunged afterwards by the scribe.

Vote - AcceptText - I agree with almost all the new readings. I would only suggest reading ἐπ̣ι̣σ̣|τελλόμενα instead of ἐπ̣ι̣|τελλόμενα in ll. 12-13: cf. P.Phil. 15.17 with BL 8.281. In l. 18, I would read the expected ἐφʼ ἅλῳ instead of σε̣φαλω (I can see a large epsilon, with the upper stroke touching the baseline; a similar, though smaller, one appears in πεν, l. 6); I’m also not entirely sure about the alleged eta prior to the scribal correction – perhaps better an iota? Lin10 I think there’s no need for question mark in πέ̣ν̣[τε]; lin11 ἐ̣γ̣ => <:ἐκ|reg|ἐγ:> (I would not dot ἐγ). Before finalizing, please remove the commas after εἴκοσι <#=20#> in l. 10 and |ἀ̣σ̣φαλῶ̣ς̣:> in l. 18 and add tag num in l. 10; in l. 26 correct typo <#γ̣=3#>[.1] => <#λ̣=30#>[.1]
Submit - Substantial corrections throughout the text

Commit - Substantial corrections: In lin6 I've made the editor's text clearer: <:<:ἐφʼ|reg|αφ:>|reg|ὠν:> => <:ἐφʼ ὃν|reg|ἀφʼ ων:>; lin10-11: based on image and parallels π[αρα]11.- λ̣α̣μ̣β̣ά̣ν̣ο̣ν̣τ̣ό̣ς̣ μου:> => <:πέ̣ν̣[τε(?)]11. λαμβάνοντός μο̣υ̣; τὰς δημοσίας => τὰ ἐ̣γ̣ δημοσίου̣; lin11-12 ἀ12.- γέλας μενασἱ̣ε̣ρ̣.2[.1].1α.3=BL 1.59|<:ἠ12.-γελασμένας|reg|ἀγελασμένας:> ἱ̣ε̣ρ̣.2[.1].1α.3 => :ἐπ̣ι̣12.- τελλ̣όμενα̣ σπ̣έρμ̣α̣τα κα̣ὶ̣; lin18 ἀ̣σ̣φαλῶ̣ς̣ <:<:ἐφʼ ἅλῳ|reg|σε̣φαλ<:ω|subst|η(?):>:>; π̣α̣ρ̣α̣σ̣τ̣ήσω => τοῦ̣ κλήρ̣ο̣[υ]; end of lin19 .4.1 => <:ναύλ̣ο̣υ̣|alt|ναύλ̣ω[ν]; lin20 οίκω̣ν => ὄν̣ων; end of lin26 .4 => ὀφ̣[ρ]ύ̣ι (despite the masculine adjective)
